mentions.title: WARNING about King Main Thrust Bearings
mentions.snippet: Explicit buyer-warning thread: poster reports King main thrust bearings made since 2024 are out of spec on free spread, slipping onto the cap and block groove with no interference fit and risking a spun bearing. Snippet states King's tech line confirmed the 2024 bearings are out of spec and one engineer said he would not use them.
mentions.replyNote: Read successfully: still no King or official reply, thread open and unresolved, most recent post still 3 June 2026 where the poster reports receiving in-spec NOS Clevite thrust bearings.
